llm_judge.note: 5 examples scored before Groq free-tier rate limit (15 RPM). Judge used qwen/qwen3.8-27b at temperature 0. Agent LLM was unavailable during this run; replies were intent-matched fallbacks, so scores reflect template reply quality, not RAG-generated replies.

human_judge_agreement.note: Very strong rank agreement (rho=0.97, p<0.001) at n=25. LLM judge consistently scores 0.15-0.25 below human on tone and actionability -- a conservative bias that is systematic and predictable. MAE of 0.21 means the judge is reliable enough to use as a proxy for human scoring at scale.
